description: This file defines and manages text editing features related to markdown-like inline formatting marks in a Slate.js editor, including shortcut handling and mark application logic.

methods.name: applyMark
methods.description: Applies a formatting mark to selected text based on a shortcut, managing undo history and text transformations.

methods.name: withMarks
methods.description: Enhances an editor instance to support markdown shortcuts and inline mark toggling based on document features and user input.

methods.name: getStartOfBlock
methods.description: Retrieves the start position of the current block element in the editor.
